assignmentHtml.task: Research Chapitosiki YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who runs this channel? Latin American children's content. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Spanish). (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Chapitosiki is #48 with ~54B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Chapitosiki with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: Chapitosiki YouTube Channel

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw
  • Handle: @Chapitosiki
  • Canonical URLs: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw ; https://www.youtube.com/@Chapitosiki
    Source: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw/about

  1. OPERATOR/CREATOR
    The channel was created and is operated by two sisters — Kamilla Shaimurdzina and Ariana — who own the twin dachshunds Chapi and Tosya. A third recurring human character, Vanya, appears alongside them in every video (sign-off reads "Ваши Камилла, Ариана, Ваня и Чапитосики" / Yours, Kamilla, Ariana, Vanya, and Chapitosiki). The LiveJournal article states they live in the Moscow region (Mytishchi). NOTE: The orchestrator's context describes this as "Latin American children's content" — this is contradicted by all evidence. Chapitosiki is a Russian-language family entertainment channel operated by Russian creators, not Latin American content.
    Sources: https://vtemah.livejournal.com/2973275.html ; https://creatordb.app/creatorstats/chapitosiki/

  2. CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD

  • Channel created: January 24, 2020 (per YouTube About page)
  • First upload: "Смешные таксы" (Funny Dachshunds), uploaded January 25, 2020
  • Still public: Yes, at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=leAYqcEbfkc — 67,664 views, 2.9K likes
    Source: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw/about ; https://insidecreateurs.com/en/channels/chapitosiki ; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=leAYqcEbfkc
  1. OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • YouTube displays: United States
  • Facebook page lists: New York, NY
  • Actual residence per investigative reporting: Moscow region (Mytishchi), Russia
  • Content published mainly in Russian for post-Soviet audiences (Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Belarus)
  • Registered as US channel, publishing mainly in RU
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw/about ; https://vtemah.livejournal.com/2973275.html ; https://insidecreateurs.com/en/channels/chapitosiki ; https://www.facebook.com/p/Chapitosiki-61566514948265/

  1. LANGUAGES
    Primary language: Russian. All videos, titles, hashtags, and community engagement are predominantly in Russian.
    Source: https://creatordb.app/creatorstats/chapitosiki/ ; https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw/about

  2. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
    Pets & Animals / Family & Kids Entertainment (also classified as Entertainment). Content has evolved from dog-centric videos to cast-driven game/challenge formats.
    Sources: https://creatordb.app/creatorstats/chapitosiki/ ; https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXmseTCR4w5q36pupOJKegw/about

  3. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
    Extremely high-frequency, short-form-dominant model:

  • ~8.4 videos/day (~60/week, ~1,210/year)
  • Overwhelmingly shorts under 3 minutes (6,704 of analyzed videos are short-form; median 593.9K views vs 39K for mid-form)
  • Format: Twin dachshunds (Chapi/Tosya) + children (Kamilla/Ariana/Vanya) in hide-and-seek, food-choice segments ("Фу или ням"), challenges, games
  • Brand ecosystem extends to mobile game, merchandise (Wildberries), grooming SPA salon in Mytishchi, Telegram, VK, TikTok
    Sources: https://insidecreateurs.com/en/channels/chapitosiki ; https://creatordb.app/creatorstats/chapitosiki/ ; https://vtemah.livejournal.com/2973275.html
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS
  • «ЗА ЧТО ЧАПИТОСИКИ ТАК?🥹🥹» — 3.26B views (most-viewed YouTube Short ever, posted June 23, 2024)
  • «ПОЧЕМУ ПОДАРКИ УДВАИВАЮТСЯ?» — 2.01B views (posted March 2, 2023)
  • «КУДА ЭЛИ СБЕЖАЛА?» (@chapitosiki.grooming) — 326M views
  • «ЧАПИ ПОДСТАВИЛА ЛИЗУ» — 200M views
  • «ЧАПИТОСИКИ ВПЕРВЫЕ УЧАТСЯ ПЛАВАТЬ В БАССЕЙНЕ» — 6.6M views
  • «POOR TOSYA VS RICH CHAPI» — 847K views (5+ years old)
  • «Смешные таксы» (first video) — 67K views (Jan 25, 2020)
    Sources: https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Most-viewed_YouTube_shorts ; https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7B8TbOr2yjk ; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=leAYqcEbfkc

STATUS NOTE: The orchestrator's characterization of Chapitosiki as "Latin American children's content" is not supported by any evidence. All sources confirm it is a Russian-language family entertainment channel operated by Russian sisters from the Moscow region, registered in the US.
